summary_after_grading.budget_scope: Minimum is only over the tested grid. No claim of a theoretical minimum, guaranteed success probability or unseen observers.
summary_after_grading.interpretation: Each budget group is a success-curve point. Repeats estimate execution noise on this artifact, not population robustness. Ratios condition on BOTH runs succeeding; inspect all outcome counts alongside them.
summary_after_grading.timeouts: not recovered within the measured budget; right-censored, not infinite effort
summary_after_grading.interval_scope: exploratory within-artifact repeated-run intervals; deterministic repeated successes are not independent program samples

timeline.scope: post hoc host filesystem timestamps; diagnostic only, not an observer duration or OS-sleep diagnosis

interpretation: Observer expansion on unchanged development binaries. Paired costs compare each candidate to its original within the NEW observer run. Source-model grades trust binary lifting. Warmups excluded. No human or memory-protection claim.
